{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Arctic LNG 2 Terminal power station''' (терминал «Утренний», Арктик СПГ-2) is an operating power station of at least 1000-megawatts (MW) in Gydan Peninsula, Yamal-Nenets, Russia with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating.
It is also known as Utrenny LNG Terminal power station.
